issues.problem: Going from $211.9B to $245.1B is a rise of about 15.7%, not 24.7%. Microsoft itself reported 16% growth.

data.summary: Most of the figures match Microsoft's reported fiscal 2024 results: revenue of $245.1B (up from $211.9B), net income of $88.1B, operating income of $109.4B, total assets of $512.2B and cash and cash equivalents of $18.3B. The growth rate is wrong. It should be about 15.7%, not 24.7%.
